title: Build Value Then Funding
definition: A strategy that emphasizes the importance of demonstrating the value of a project before seeking financial support.

difficulty_levels.beginner: The idea is to focus on creating something valuable first, and then seek funding to support its growth.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The Build Value, Then Funding strategy emphasizes the importance of demonstrating the value of a project before seeking financial support.
difficulty_levels.expert: The Build Value, Then Funding strategy is a fundamental shift in the traditional startup model. It highlights the importance of creating value for users and contributors before seeking financial support.

extra_fields.insight: The success of a project is not determined by its funding, but by its ability to create value for its users and contributors.
